exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: What kinds of fast food have you tried? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Do you ever use a microwave to cook food quickly? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: How popular are fast food restaurants where you live? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: When would you go to a fast-food restaurant? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe some technology (e.g. an app, phone, software program) that you decided to stop using. You should say: when and where you got this technology why you started using this technology why you decided to stop using it and explain how you feel about the decision you made.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: What kinds of computer games do people play in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Why do people enjoy playing computer games?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you think that all computer games should have a minimum age for players?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: In what ways can technology in the classroom be helpful?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Do you agree that students are often better at using technology than their teachers?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Do you believe that computers will ever replace human teachers?
